game_title: Call Stack Tower – Firewood Stacks Trial
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Firewood Stacks, towering firewood stacks: the frost mage must handle winter bandits while practicing functions. Core idea – Call Stack Tower: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order.
theme: Snowy Hold – Firewood Stacks: towering firewood stacks
core_gameplay_loop: In Firewood Stacks, repeat each round: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the stack_height value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the frozen well using at most 10 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The frozen well reached with actions_used <= 10.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 10 before the frozen well is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 1 (intro tier): Call Stack Tower
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
